description: This file declares a set of utility functions and macros for memory management, file operations, system calls, and cryptographic random number generation, intended for use in a larger C project.

methods.name: xstrdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string, similar to strdup.

methods.name: xmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of given size, with error handling.

methods.name: xmallocz
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory of given size.

methods.name: xmallocz_gently
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory with gentle error handling.

methods.name: xmemdupz
methods.description: Duplicates a block of memory with zero termination.

methods.name: xstrndup
methods.description: Duplicates a string up to a specified length.

methods.name: xrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory block.

methods.name: xcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized array.

methods.name: xsetenv
methods.description: Sets environment variable.

methods.name: xmmap
methods.description: Memory maps a file or region.

methods.name: mmap_os_err
methods.description: Returns error message for mmap failures.

methods.name: xmmap_gently
methods.description: Memory maps with gentle error handling.

methods.name: xopen
methods.description: Opens a file with variadic flags.

methods.name: xread
methods.description: Reads from file descriptor.

methods.name: xwrite
methods.description: Writes to file descriptor.

methods.name: xpread
methods.description: Positional read from file descriptor.

methods.name: xdup
methods.description: Duplicates a file descriptor.

methods.name: xfopen
methods.description: Opens a file stream.

methods.name: xfdopen
methods.description: Creates a FILE* from a file descriptor.

methods.name: xmkstemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file.

methods.name: xmkstemp_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with mode.

methods.name: xgetcwd
methods.description: Gets current working directory.

methods.name: fopen_for_writing
methods.description: Opens a file for writing.

methods.name: fopen_or_warn
methods.description: Opens a file or warns on failure.

methods.name: xstrncmpz
methods.description: Compares strings with NUL-termination consideration.

methods.name: xsnprintf
methods.description: Formatted string with buffer size limit.

methods.name: xgethostname
methods.description: Gets hostname.

methods.name: git_mkdtemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory.

methods.name: git_mkstemps_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with permissions.

methods.name: git_mkstemp_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with mode.

methods.name: read_in_full
methods.description: Reads full buffer from file descriptor.

methods.name: write_in_full
methods.description: Writes full buffer to file descriptor.

methods.name: pread_in_full
methods.description: Positional read full buffer.

methods.name: write_str_in_full
methods.description: Writes string fully to file descriptor.

methods.name: write_file_buf
methods.description: Writes buffer to file, truncating first.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Formats and writes data to file.

methods.name: is_missing_file
methods.description: Checks if file is missing.

methods.name: is_empty_or_missing_file
methods.description: Checks if file is empty or missing.

methods.name: git_fsync
methods.description: Fsyncs a file descriptor with specified action.

methods.name: unlink_or_warn
methods.description: Unlinks a file, warns on error except ENOENT.

methods.name: unlink_or_msg
methods.description: Unlinks a file, reports error message.

methods.name: rmdir_or_warn
methods.description: Removes directory or warns.

methods.name: access_or_warn
methods.description: Checks access, warns on error.

methods.name: access_or_die
methods.description: Checks access, terminates on error.

methods.name: warn_on_fopen_errors
methods.description: Warns on fopen errors.

methods.name: open_nofollow
methods.description: Opens file with O_NOFOLLOW.

methods.name: sleep_millisec
methods.description: Sleeps for specified milliseconds.

methods.name: csprng_bytes
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: git_rand
methods.description: Returns a random uint32.

methods.name: log2u
methods.description: Computes log2 of size_t.
